notes.title: YO FUJII给中国玩家的话
notes.content:
在游戏发售后，我们收到了很多玩家们走心的玩后感。对此，YO FUJII特地给中国玩家写了一封信，感谢大家对这款游戏的支持。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621114/045108b7c943ab17d489d028701c1e20d50860a5.png[/img]

图译：
中国的玩家们，你们好！

非常感谢中国玩家们对《GOODBYE WORLD》的高度评价！

虽然这是一个让人郁郁寡欢的游戏，但我想通过这个游戏告诉大家的是“不要忘记最初的那份冲动”的想法和“希望珍惜人与人之间的连结”的愿望，以及“追逐梦想的宝贵”。

希望这部作品能够向大家传达到这些想法。

祝大家玩得愉快！
YO FUJII

在此，我们想邀请各位中国玩家将自己的所思所感与大家分享。让大家通过游戏心得分享活动，给彼此不同的思想声音一个展示、交流和碰撞的空间。

[h3][b]【活动时间】[/b][/h3]
游玩心得分享活动起止时间：
[b]2022年11月19日——12月2日下午2点[/b]
获奖名单公布时间：
[b]2022年12月3日下午3点[/b]

[h3][b]【参与方式&活动规则】[/b][/h3]
[olist]
[*] 在活动时间内，以文字、图片、视频等形式，将对《GoodBye World》的游玩心得发布到[b]微博或B站[/b]，并且[b]在微博@独立方舟_IndieArk，在B站@IndieArk[/b]。
[*] 分享要求：[b]内容不限，字数不限[/b]，形式三选一即可。可以是一句话表达你的所思所感，可以是分享你感受最深的游戏截图和台词，也可以关于是“BLOCKS”的精彩操作。
[*] 活动结束前可多次分享游玩心得，但每位玩家只有一次获奖机会。
[*] 活动期间将不定期在微博/B站转发展示玩家们的分享。参与活动的玩家默认允许公开其分享、昵称等信息。内容及昵称禁止包含敏感词汇。
[*] 禁止搬运、抄袭、盗用别人的分享，一经发现将取消参与资格。
[*] 玩家兑奖时需展示Steam库里有《GOODBYE WORLD》该游戏的截图。
[*] IndieArk独立方舟保留活动最终解释权。
[/olist]

[h3][b]【活动奖品】[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621114/dcce171f4f472bdb4686c5a25a2604d29034e67d.png[/img]
《GOODBYE WORLD》周边帆布包+5美金Steam点卡[b]（共10位）[/b]

我们将在公布最终名单后14个工作日内通过私信联系获奖玩家，并发放奖品。如遇不可控情况，奖品可能会稍微晚一点抵达哦~

We hope you enjoy this game!

notes.title: 【GOODBYE WORLD】New Main Visual & Character Visuals Released!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! It's KOU from Flyhigh Works.

About a month ago, we released the【GOODBYE WORLD】STEAM Store page, but the developer has provided some main visual and character illustrations, so we will introduce them right away.


～～

[h3]Main Visual[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621114/d56a264ae586722c7ad10543432b986094573249.jpg[/img]

Here is the Main Visual

Let's listen to developer YO FUJII san talk a little about it.

[b]KOU[/b]　The Main Visual is cute. There are various interesting things in this scene that I'm curious about, especially the game console on the desk. Is it related to the story? 

[b]YO FUJII[/b]　That's right.
This game console is not only an essential part of progressing the story in the game, but it is also an indispensable item for one of the protagonists, Kanii.



[b]KOU[/b]　The logo on the laptop looks like it's shaped like a"3 ". Is this also related to the story?

[b]YO FUJII[/b]　This logo is actually a pear that was bitten into (a parody of the Apple logo...), but it has nothing to do with the story.




[h3]Characters Introductions[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621114/ec6ea95a70273116a927f323d25aca7542457dee.png[/img]
■蟹井（Kanii）
One of the protagonists. She develops indie games with the other protagonist, Kumade. Kanii is mainly in charge of programming and game design. 

She is not good at having relationships with people and tends to speak rudely to others...

Kanii is shy and often alone. She always carries along with her favorite retro game console from back in the day. 

When she first met Kumade, Kanii felt put off towards her, but nowadays, she feels Kumade is the only one that can develop games with her. 

Game development is not a stable source of income, so she inevitably works at a part-time job that she's not really enthusiastic about... 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621114/ac74f2321293c9c525523a16340d3ac3c7280249.png[/img]
■熊手（Kumade）

The other protagonists. Kumade is the other game developer who Kanii makes indie games with. She is in charge of graphics and scenario writing.



Kumade is cheerful, bright, and a good person, but not everybody's friend. She has a communicative spirit and can adequately express her opinions.

She connects and closes the distance between her and Kanii with her communicative abilities. She now is more of a protector of Kanii.  

Contrary to Kanii, who can't keep a part-time job, Kumade works long shifts and almost single-handedly covers their living expenses.

She feels anxiety about the future, and she cares more about Kanii's well-being than anyone else, so she is always concerned about what is best for them both... 





The main characters are cute and fantastic!

Looking forward to the day to be able to play this upcoming promising title.


～～

[h3]Afterword[/h3]

In conclusion, what do you think about the【GOODBYE WORLD】main visual and character illustrations?

That’s the end of this article!
